must_identify.item: The api Service targetPort is 9090 while the api container listens on 8080, so connections from the frontend are refused (502)
must_identify.evidence: the live Service spec had `targetPort: 9090` [13, 15], while the Deployment's container only exposes `containerPort: 8080` [11] ... which has nothing listening on it, producing connection-refused errors for every Service-routed request — manifesting as nginx's 502 responses on `/api/`

must_identify.item: The worker's warnings and errors are not the cause of the frontend 5xx
must_identify.evidence: Health and configuration of the redis, worker, and loadgen deployments — no symptoms or alerts pointed to these components, so they were not examined.

notes: The root cause is correctly identified. The worker was never examined, so the RCA does not address its DeprecationWarning and metrics-push errors; it only excludes the worker by omission. The RCA mentions that a fix was 'validated' but never states it explicitly. It implies reverting targetPort to 8080 via the last-applied annotation, so a reviewer may want to credit the fix.
